projects.title: Jordan Language Academy
projects.description: A freelance client website for a language academy in Jordan, built to rank in both Google and AI search from day one. I handled design, build and on-page SEO/GEO — structured data, fast Core Web Vitals, and content shaped for the questions real students ask.

projects.title: Medical Chatbot Bias Analysis
projects.description: My honours thesis: an automated pipeline that audits consumer medical AI chatbots for demographic bias, measuring how their advice shifts across patient age, gender and clinical background. Turns a fuzzy fairness question into a repeatable, quantified test.

projects.title: Advertising Effectiveness Analysis
projects.description: A capstone project I built in a team of six with an industry partner: a computer-vision system that measures how shoppers engage with advertising screens in shopping centres, giving retailers real-time feedback on which ads actually hold attention.

projects.title: Volume Control
projects.description: A desktop app that turns hand gestures into real-time system volume control, built with OpenCV and MediaPipe hand tracking — no hardware, just your webcam.

projects.title: AI Photo Roaster
projects.description: A playful web app that light-heartedly roasts your photos using computer vision and generative AI, with safety filters to keep it funny rather than mean.

projects.title: AxiomChat
projects.description: A Chrome extension that lets crypto traders chat right beside live charts, with sentiment analysis and AI-generated insights on each coin.

projects.title: Chronic Kidney Disease Predictor
projects.description: Machine-learning models that estimate a patient's risk of chronic kidney disease from clinical data, benchmarked across algorithms to find the most reliable predictor.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: The site you're on — built from scratch in Vue 3 and Tailwind, with a data-driven project showroom that syncs from GitHub each month.

projects.title: P2P File-Transfer Program
projects.description: A peer-to-peer file-transfer program in C that sends and receives files in chunks and flags corrupted or anomalous data on the way.

projects.title: Space Invaders Game
projects.description: A full Space Invaders clone in Java with added mechanics on top of the classic arcade loop, designed with GoF patterns (Factory Method, State, Builder, Strategy) then extended inside an unfamiliar codebase.

projects.title: Multi-type Linked List
projects.description: A generic, multi-type linked list in C with a demo program covering insertion, traversal and memory-safe cleanup.

projects.title: Scroll Manager
projects.description: A Java program for managing and updating binary 'digital scroll' records. Uses a low-level file for memory manipulation.

projects.title: The Ecology of Harm — Predictors of Domestic Violence Across NSW
projects.description: An independent research project testing which socio-economic and environmental factors best predict domestic-violence assault rates across 129 NSW regions, using regression modelling on three merged public datasets.

projects.title: Nutrition E-Textbook — Interactive Prototype
projects.description: Designed and prototyped an interactive nutrition e-textbook combining a vegetable-serving logger with linked learning content, evaluated across multiple iterations with real users.

projects.title: Quality-of-Life Factor Analysis & Regression
projects.description: A group project constructing a quality-of-life measure via factor analysis and testing five theory-driven hypotheses about its drivers, using survey data from ~1,800 respondents.

projects.title: AI-Powered Online Fashion Store
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with LLM-generated review summaries and a product Q&A chatbot, built with Spring Boot and React across a 4–5 person team.

projects.title: Microservices E-Commerce System
projects.description: A microservices-based online store integrating banking, delivery and email services with a hybrid sync/async messaging model and explicit fault-tolerance handling for partial service failures.

projects.title: RESTful API Design & System Reliability Modelling
projects.description: Designed a RESTful resource scheme for an app-store system, modelled transaction throughput/latency under a mixed workload, and computed MTTF/MTTR/availability for a system and its redundant version.

projects.title: Classifying Alzheimer's Disease from Brain MRI
projects.description: A neuroimaging pipeline that classifies Alzheimer's Disease vs. healthy controls from MRI scans, combining an FSL-based preprocessing pipeline I built with an SVM classifier reaching 100% cross-validation accuracy.

projects.title: Swillow — Smart Pillowcase for Sleep Apnoea Screening
projects.description: A 5-person interdisciplinary project designing a non-invasive smart pillowcase for early sleep apnoea screening; I built the ML pipeline that classifies apnoea risk from audio at 91% accuracy, and built the website that fronts it for the startup pitch.

projects.title: Tomato Leaf-Disease Detector with Custom Fourier Loss
projects.description: An object detector that spots seven tomato-leaf disease types, built on YOLOv8 with a custom loss term operating in the frequency domain to catch small, high-frequency lesions.

projects.title: Software Quality & Reliability Testing on an Open-Source Game
projects.description: Applied formal software-quality and verification techniques — unit testing, cyclomatic-complexity analysis, finite-state-machine testing and Markov-chain reliability modelling — to real features of the open-source game Mindustry.

projects.title: MRI Processing, Segmentation & Classification
projects.description: Neuroimaging work from raw scan to prediction: a solo FSL pipeline turning a raw brain MRI into quantitative grey-matter volume measurements for specific regions via skull-stripping, tissue segmentation and atlas-based registration, plus multi-planar MRI visualization, classical edge detection, K-means image segmentation, and SVM classification with hyperparameter tuning.

projects.title: Classifier Comparison — Diabetes & Room Occupancy Datasets
projects.description: Implemented Naive Bayes and k-NN classifiers from scratch and benchmarked them against Weka's built-in classifiers on two real datasets, reaching 99% accuracy on the occupancy dataset.

projects.title: Image-Denoising Neural Network
projects.description: A convolutional neural network that restores images corrupted by Gaussian or speckle noise, lifting PSNR from a 28.2 dB noisy baseline to 30.4 dB restored.

projects.title: Broken Printer — Multi-Strategy AI Search Solver
projects.description: Implemented and compared six classical AI search strategies — BFS, DFS, IDS, Greedy, A*, and Hill-climbing — to solve a bit-flipping colour-correction puzzle.

projects.title: Academic Discussion Platform — Requirements to Deployment
projects.description: Took a Django web application from requirements and design through implementation and AWS deployment, with authentication, a RESTful API, and security hardening, across a 5-person team.

projects.title: PKI/TLS, Key Exchange, IPSec & Firewall Design
projects.description: Inspected real TLS handshakes and certificate chains, built a custom 3-level X.509 chain, attacked a session-key protocol, and designed firewall rule sets for a given network.

projects.title: Communication Networks — Protocol Analysis Lab Series
projects.description: A series of hands-on packet-capture labs analysing ICMP, TCP, HTTP, DHCP and DNS traffic, including a custom Python UDP probe script, in a 3-person team.

projects.title: Classical & Modern Cryptography
projects.description: Broke a Vigenère cipher via cryptanalysis, worked through CBC ciphertext-stealing and RSA key-generation examples, and factored a weak RSA modulus to recover a plaintext message.

projects.title: Security Goals, Social Engineering & Access Control
projects.description: Analysed the security goals compromised in 10 real-world breaches, a social-engineering case study, and hands-on access-control/privilege-escalation tasks on a Linux VM.

projects.title: NeighbourLink — Car-Sharing Web Information System
projects.description: As part of a 4-person team, researched, designed and prototyped a car-sharing platform connecting drivers and riders, from requirements through a working web prototype and pitch video.

projects.title: Software Testing Toolchain — Coverage, Fuzzing & Grammar-Based Generation
projects.description: Built a coverage analyser, a mutation-based fuzzer, and a grammar-based fuzzer from scratch in Python, plus a regex-to-grammar converter and a property/contract-based test suite.

projects.title: Geometry Processing Pipeline — Point Generator & Triangle Searcher
projects.description: A two-program pipeline in C: one generates randomized 2D points under a minimum-distance constraint, the other finds the closest points and checks whether they form a triangle.

projects.title: Virtual Scroll Access System — Scrum Team Project
projects.description: A Java file-sharing application with tiered accounts and hashed-password auth, built across 3 Scrum sprints with full CI/CD (Jenkins, JUnit) while rotating through every Scrum role.

projects.title: Database Design & Systems — Modelling to Deployment
projects.description: A full database sequence taken end to end: an Extended ER model for a rental-accommodation matching service built from a textual domain description, an ER-to-relational translation for a student-clubs domain into PostgreSQL DDL across 20 edge-case scenarios, a Flask + PostgreSQL transport app extended with full CRUD and custom aggregate reports (hosting the shared database as the team's data owner), and written work on relational algebra, BCNF normalization, index selection and a password-storage security critique.

projects.title: Cybersecurity in E-Commerce
projects.description: As part of a 5-person team, designed and prototyped a React e-commerce site adding encrypted account tiers, MFA, and a trusted-seller rating system, run via Agile sprints.

projects.title: Chess Variant with AI Opponent
projects.description: A 14×14 chess-variant game with full legal-move generation for 10 piece types, check/checkmate detection, and a heuristic AI opponent, built solo with the Processing graphics library.

projects.title: Chat Forum Moderator Program
projects.description: A multi-mode moderation tool that parses custom forum file formats, ranks users by a personality score, and censors banned words, backed by a black-box unit test suite.

projects.title: Personalized Gym Workout Program
projects.description: A command-line Python program that interviews a gym member and generates a personalized weekly workout plan, with age-based intensity scaling.

projects.title: Autonomous Maze-Navigating Robot
projects.description: Designed autonomous maze-navigation logic in a custom C simulator, then ported it to a physical Arduino-based robot with IR sensors under tight lab-time constraints.
